Twine (John Hancock) · Product Design Lead · 2019

Twine: the anti-retirement calculator

  • 3×
    Apple App of the Day
  • 4.6
    App Store rating
  • $20M
    AUM

The market’s retirement calculators ask users to type their entire life story into a form and respond with a giant scary number. Our hypothesis was that users didn’t want a number — they wanted to know if they could retire at all, and what to do about it.

In two weeks I led divergent exploration, narrowed on a quiz-first format, and built a Figma prototype that we tested head-to-head with NerdWallet. Users consistently responded better to "you can retire at 67" plus actionable advice than to a six-figure goal. The MVP segmented advice into three buckets — on-track, behind, and way-behind — each with appropriate language and a different call to action. Twine shut down before we shipped, but the prototype validated a new approach to financial empathy that I still draw from today.
